title: Computerkunst (Polygoon Hollands Nieuws, Weeknummer 86-12) / Computer art
license: CC-BY-SA 3.0 NL (Open Beelden / Beeld en Geluid)
notes: Netherlands, Dutch: Polygoon Hollands Nieuws, 1986 — 'de invloed van de computer wordt steeds meer zichtbaar': the plotter and the printout, computer-made images hung in a gallery, a long unbroken pass over the generated imagery, a young operator at his workstation, and a computer-drawn cartoon. Source MP4 rendition from openbeelden.nl; the closing 'Ende' card, the POLYGOON JOURNAAL logo and the black tail are not used.
